messages:
alice: Heads-up: saw an unexpected p95 regression on the FP8 mixed-precision path after yesterday's calibration tweak. Per-token latency up ~18% on long prompts. Logs + sample traces below.

ben: Which calibration change? the new "energy_clip" schedule? can you paste the perf trace?

alice: Yes, changed clip_slope from 0.7 -> 0.85 in calib v3. Attaching perf snippet from per-token breakdown (1k-step sample). Kernel counters show increased fallback to int8 kernel for matmul on layer 22-24.

chiara: paste the snippet please

alice: ```
perfbot:trace id=tx-789
p50: 23ms p95: 118ms
per_token: token0..token512
kernel_select: fp8_matmul_v2 (65%), int8_matmul_fallback (35%)
fallback_count: 34
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.82 overall, but layer22: 0.52
batching_window_ms: 8
```

dan: hmm layer-specific kv hit drop looks suspicious. Did KV cache serialization change with calib v3? maybe alignment/quant rounding changed keys so misses spike.

ben: I saw similar in local repro: when we quantize keys with fp8-symmetric, small float differences make cache keys diverge for long-context rollouts. Confirmed >20% more cache misses for repeated prefixes.

perf-bot: automated compare: baseline (calib v2) p95 100ms, current (v3) p95 118ms, tokens/sec -12%

alice: repro steps I ran:
- model: rw-3b-quant-mp
- checkpoint: q-v3
- run: ./perf/run_trace.sh --seed 42 --length 512 --batch 1
- trace: outputs/tx-789.json

chiara: can you run a kernel counter dump? `RW_RUNTIME_TRACE=1 ./bin/runtime --trace-kernels ...` need matmul kernel counts per layer.

alice: dumped counters, snippet:
```
layer22: fp8_matmul_v2=1200, int8_matmul_fallback=780
layer23: fp8_matmul_v2=1100, int8_matmul_fallback=800
layer24: fp8_matmul_v2=1005, int8_matmul_fallback=900
```

dan: those fallback ratios are high. suggests kernel selection heuristic flipped because measured tensor variance changed after calib. Where does the heuristic compute variance? model loader or first-token warmup?

ben: kernel selection runs on per-layer profiling of activation var during first N tokens (default N=4). If calib changes scale, selection can prefer int8 fallback due to estimated overflow risk.

chiara: idea: make selection use historical KV cache distributions when cache_hit_rate > 0.5 to prefer fp8 despite variance for warmed layers.

alice: temporary mitigations:
- pin kernel selector to always prefer fp8 for rw-3b models: ENV RW_KERNEL_FORCE=fp8
- rollback calib to v2 for affected tenants

ben: T-shirt estimate: if we force-fp8 on warmed layers, expected p95 drop back to ~102ms per perf-bot mimic.

perf-bot: note: forcing kernels bypasses safety checks, risk of NaN regressions in certain inputs. Use only as short-term.

dan: action items:
- alice: open PR to add "cache-aware kernel fallback" heuristic (assign)
- ben: add diagnostic flag to dump quantized KV fingerprints (assign)
- chiara: run broader repro across dataset to quantify how often alignment causes miss (assign)
- dan: coordinate rollback for customer clusters if they hit >15% perf regression (assign)

alice: opened issue: https://redwood/issue/INF-2491 with logs + repro

ben: quick note: also saw small quality diffs (decode tokens shift) likely from quant rounding — include evals in regression checklist.

alice: thanks all, will follow up once "cache-aware kernel" PR has perf numbers. :thumbsup:
